headline.text: Repair cafe lamp fix, tram errands, bakery and library stop.

narrative.text: The morning began at home with a quiet breakfast and notes about a lamp wiring sketch. After checking the lamp base and switch details in the notebook, I gathered an umbrella and jacket and headed out the door.

Most of the day centered on Fernhollow Repair Cafe. The desk lamp's cracked switch was the main problem. We opened the base, removed four screws, tested the cord with a multimeter, and planned for a replacement switch to arrive Tuesday. I paused the recording around midday and returned by one.

Later I stopped at Quill Street Bakery for a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns, then visited Larkspur Community Library. The reserved lamp repair manual will be ready Tuesday afternoon, and the library card was renewed for another year. The day closed with a rainy tram ride home at dusk.

people.text: The repair cafe volunteer helped diagnose the cracked switch, tested the cord, and said the replacement switch would arrive Tuesday.
The bakery staff member offered warm cinnamon buns and repeated the order.
The library staff member said the reserved manual would be ready Tuesday afternoon and renewed the library card.
